reviews.review:
I waited a couple days to really analyze why disliked this game so much. First off, the game is half-baked. An afterthought. There are 3 major features missing from this "roguelite" game if you can even call it that. 

1. Map progression. The fortnite storm is such a terrible idea, it removes any of the environmental RNG when you play on the exact same map with the same POIs, and the only difference is "I wonda where da sirkul will end up". This turns the gameplay loop into the same "sprint to where the max xp is" every single time, and the route becomes the same too, because they made the boss and elite variation the same. It needed linear, "room based" progression like a traditional roguelite. The Souls games already have this, it was such an easy thing to do and they couldve had so many assets to recycle. Example, one map is based on sen's fortress from DS1 and you run through randomized rooms within it, some rooms have upgrade vendors, weapon vendors, some rooms have extra loot, at certain intervals you hit a room with an elite, some rooms with trash mobs, and then a mini-boss up to the end with the big main boss. This would have made the gameplay loop amazing.

2. Skill trees/meta progression. Why is this not a feature? Don't even try and say "but the relics!" because the relics are so inconsequential I beat 4 nightlords with the exact same relics I got from my first run. What the progression should look like is: Unique skill trees for each character specific to how they are supposed to play. Example, Recluse has a skill tree that has several small points that increase FP or FP regen/reduce usage, and those lead to larger points that unlock powerful abilities/equipment etcetera. As of now, the only thing you actually get is relics, so basically there is no reason to grind unless you just happen to find the gameplay loop fun. 

3. Class specific weapons. Might be controversial but I think if each character was locked to specific weapons, it would solve the fact that the characters just feel like stat skins. As it is, the only reason to switch characters is aesthetics or ultimate abilities, other than that it doesn't really matter at all. Locking weapons makes choosing a character much more consequential, and opens up the doors to the proposed skill tree to enhance those weapons and base the abilities off of them. 

Plus, the relics could be redone with the 3 changes I mentioned so that you could shape character builds against whatever nightlord you're running against. 

These are such basic features of a roguelite, and if they spent just one more year on this game doing these things, even if it wasn't fully polished yet, it would have made for such a better game. Slapping "Elden Ring" on a game that shares ZERO things with Elden Ring other than the assets and the name is just backhanded. Nightreign plays nothing like Elden Ring save for some of the combat, but even then it falls short because the boss design philosophy is based around team comp burst damage, and if your team isn't using poise break or status procs you'll basically be chipping away at the boss for 30 min.

I really wanted to like this game, a souls-like roguelite has such a nice ring to it. Being $40, I wish this was treated with a little more TLC than just being an afterthought. It's a slap in the face to basically sell us a modded asset flip with IP branding and charge that much, and honestly with the amount of content/repetitive gameloop I don't think I'd even play this if it was free.
Game is pretty bad no sense of progression just mindlessly running around for an hour at a time.
